d:
This is the history of black dog sailor moon library.
2013.06.28 I saw black dog artwork first and I never forget the excited feeling about this.
2014.10.10 I was ill because of massive intestinal bleeding.I stayed at home and felt very boring and very sad.And I recalled the artwork of black dog，at that time，the black dog artwork Chinese language version is really few. So I want to translate,to spend boring time,to recover my body.
So in 2015.3.01 at that time,the work of translating black dog artwork has been finished,and I really feel that black dog is not only a doujinshi artist but also a great man.His loyalty to sailor moon，
his perseverance，makes me feel so moved in my mind.So I started to do the work of collecting his artwork.There were many black dog artwork which was not scanned and shared in the network,
in the e-hentai website.I have done the work for ten years.
Now,I am sure that black dog master cannot draw and print sailor moon donjinshi artwork again because he is not only too old
but also, may be warned by some one who is big in the area of sailor moon.Because black dog master is a too big target in the area of sailor moon.
So,the spirit of sailor moon donjinshi in the body of black dog master is....game over,he cannot draw and print sailor moon again ,I am sure.
But the spirit of sailor moon donjinshi is not dead,because I get the spirit of sailor moon donjinshi from him,because the job of collecting and translating his artwork I have done for ten years.
I am the Founder Of Black Dog Library.
Black Dog Library,it is not only a library but also is a coffin，it buries the spirit of sailor moon donjinshi in the body of black dog master forever,forever and forever.
And the sailor moon games and music collection is burial objects which is Dedicated to Black Dog Master.
So this is why I say that you should play the game and listen the music from the library.
